title: crypto2dev_shash.c: register SHA-2/3, HMAC, CMAC
description: Register nine shash algorithms as standalone composed names (NOT primitives for the kernel hmac template to wrap). Algorithms: sha256, sha384, sha512, sha3-256, sha3-512, hmac(sha256), hmac(sha384), hmac(sha512), cmac(aes). Each uses the wolfCrypt streaming API: wc_InitSha*/wc_Sha*Update/wc_Sha*Final for hashes; wc_HmacSetKey/wc_HmacUpdate/wc_HmacFinal for HMAC; wc_InitCmac/wc_CmacUpdate/wc_CmacFinal for CMAC. .descsize must equal sizeof the corresponding wolfCrypt context struct.
design: CRITICAL: register 'hmac(sha256)' as a standalone algorithm with its own .setkey — do NOT register 'sha256' alone and rely on the kernel's hmac template. This ensures wolfCrypt's HMAC implementation is used end-to-end for FIPS. Same logic for cmac(aes). .cra_name must match exactly what /proc/crypto shows on a vanilla kernel. See DESIGN.md §shash.
